scope: All 80 frozen cases; beta=2; no case or hyperparameter selection
method: Join frozen CSV records by case_id and condition, check repeated condition consistency, compare sorted token sets in oracle_mask_plan.json, and count all 80 cases. Extra action span matches use the paired case's action_spans at identical prompt positions, with unchanged guideline prefix; unmatched positions are not assigned a semantic role here.

extraActionMatches.text: Offer other locally available STI testing options (for example in-person attendance at specialist clinics, community pharmacies, primary care, or outreach services).
No MRI, FDG PET/CT, or CT accessible: guideline does not specify alternative imaging; proceed with available resources and clinical judgment.

If cPOCUS must be used in the acutely unstable neonate, limit it to its recommended scope (line tip location, effusions, qualitative volume status and systolic performance) and arrange definitive imaging (standard TNE or pediatric echocardiography) as soon as feasible.

limitations: No new forward pass or statistical testing performed.
Saved predictions and masks are rechecked; causal attribution to individual spans or attention normalization is not established.
Oracle target IDs are evaluation references and cannot be used as a deployable rule selector.
Prior confidence intervals and p-values are from the earlier report, not recomputed in this review.
